joint_warning: 鷄豬同时缺可使三栏齐断；截至323 W35/40/45为6/7/8期；豬缺蛇有为10/12/13期。无1路仅必断单；无2路或无偶2使二三断；三栏须两个不同2路肖。全栏需5肖，0/1/2至少2/1/2，至少2奇3偶，均仅必要条件。
limits: 324 already supplied before reconstruction; no pre-draw, blind, published, unbiased-selection or predictive-strength claim. First six only for selection and settlement; seventh solely raw and seven-ball identity.
